title: Gratitude and contentment
learning_outcomes: Explain gratitude versus forced positivity in the context of gratitude and contentment.
Compare and distinguish adaptation in the context of gratitude and contentment.
Apply noticing in the context of gratitude and contentment.
Evaluate and justify decisions about limits in the context of gratitude and contentment.

lessons.title: Gratitude versus forced positivity
lessons.outcome: Explain gratitude versus forced positivity in the context of gratitude and contentment.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving gratitude versus forced positivity; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to voluntary appreciation experiment.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain gratitude versus forced positivity from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of gratitude versus forced positivity; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Adaptation
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish adaptation in the context of gratitude and contentment.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving adaptation; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to voluntary appreciation experiment.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain adaptation from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of adaptation; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Noticing
lessons.outcome: Apply noticing in the context of gratitude and contentment.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving noticing; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to voluntary appreciation experiment.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain noticing from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of noticing; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Limits
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about limits in the context of gratitude and contentment.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving limits; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to voluntary appreciation experiment.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain limits from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of limits; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of gratitude versus forced positivity; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of adaptation; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of noticing; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of limits; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.

safety.notes: Draft educational framework only. Use fictional cases; no personal diagnosis, prescription, hazardous practice, financial/legal instruction or unqualified certification. Obtain qualified/local review before publication.
